method: Scan exact 0x96 0x67 records against the 36-field forge schema, parse 26-field presence bitmap and typed item_no/cost arrays; join method IDs to 57-key machine_way_data index; ingredient names via typed item_data name pointer and exact installed English map.
limits: Forge records are installed configuration, not proof of current unlock/availability or actual player-owned ingredients.
Configured seconds is a typed field, not a timed live craft observation; speed modifiers may change timing.
No forge_no key or season variant is inferred where the record does not bind it.
An unindexed ingredient item ID remains unlabeled rather than guessed.
